bugs.title: Login endpoint returns 500 on empty password field
bugs.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. POST /api/auth/login with JSON body: {"email": "user@example.com", "password": ""}
2. Server responds with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error
3. Error log shows: NullPointerException in PasswordHasher.verify()

Expected: 400 Bad Request with validation error
Actual: 500 crash, potentially leaking stack trace to client

bugs.title: Dashboard chart renders with wrong date range after timezone change
bugs.body:
When a user changes their profile timezone from UTC to PST, the analytics dashboard charts continue to show data in UTC. The date axis labels are wrong and the daily aggregations are shifted by 8 hours.

Reproduction:
1. Set profile timezone to America/Los_Angeles
2. Navigate to Analytics > Overview
3. Chart shows yesterday's data starting at 8 PM instead of midnight

Affects all chart types (line, bar, pie). Confirmed on Chrome and Firefox.

bugs.title: Database connection pool exhausted under moderate load
bugs.body:
Production alert: DB connection pool hitting max limit (100 connections) during normal business hours with ~200 concurrent users. New requests queue and timeout after 30s.

Metrics from Datadog:
- Avg connections in use: 98/100 (9am-5pm)
- Query P99 latency jumped from 120ms to 8000ms
- 3% of requests returning 503 during peak

Suspect: Long-running analytics queries not releasing connections, or connection leak in the new reporting module deployed last Tuesday.

bugs.title: Typo in onboarding email subject line
bugs.body:
The welcome email sent to new users has a typo in the subject line.

Current: "Welcme to Our Platform!"
Expected: "Welcome to Our Platform!"

This affects all new registrations. Not urgent but looks unprofessional.

bugs.title: API rate limiter bypassed via IPv6 addresses
bugs.body:
Security finding: Our rate limiter tracks clients by IPv4 address. Clients using IPv6 addresses (or toggling between IPv4/IPv6) can bypass rate limits entirely.

Proof of concept:
1. Run the attached script that alternates between IPv4 and IPv6 on loopback
2. 10,000 requests sent in 60 seconds — none rate-limited

Rate limit policy is 100 req/min per IP. This allows unlimited scraping, credential stuffing, and API abuse. Affects all public endpoints.

bugs.title: CSV export missing last row when total rows divisible by 1000
bugs.body:
When exporting data to CSV, if the total number of rows is exactly divisible by 1000 (e.g. 2000, 3000), the last row is omitted from the export file.

Reproduction:
1. Create exactly 2000 records
2. Export to CSV
3. Open CSV — only 1999 rows present

With 2001 records, all 2001 are exported correctly. Off-by-one error in pagination logic (page size = 1000).

bugs.title: Kubernetes pods OOMKilled during nightly batch job
bugs.body:
Every night at 2am the batch processing pods are killed with OOMKilled status. The nightly report generation job processes ~5M records and the pods hit the 2GB memory limit.

k8s events:
Killed pod batch-worker-xyz Reason: OOMKilled
Limits: memory=2Gi, cpu=1000m

Options:
1. Increase memory limit to 4Gi
2. Stream records instead of loading all into memory
3. Split job into smaller chunks

Nightly reports are delayed by 4-6 hours while pods restart.

bugs.title: User profile pictures not loading in Safari 16
bugs.body:
Profile pictures fail to load for users on Safari 16.x on macOS Ventura. The image element shows a broken image icon. Chrome and Firefox work fine.

Network tab shows the image request succeeds (200 OK) but Safari fails to render it. The images are served as WebP format — Safari 16 added WebP support but our Content-Type header is incorrectly set to image/jpeg for WebP files.

Affects approximately 12% of our user base (Safari users).

pull_requests.title: Add JWT refresh token rotation
pull_requests.body:
## Summary
Implements refresh token rotation as recommended by OAuth 2.0 security best practices.

## Changes
- New `POST /api/auth/refresh` endpoint
- Refresh tokens now single-use (rotated on each use)
- Old refresh token invalidated immediately after rotation
- Added `refresh_token_family` tracking to detect token reuse attacks

## Code snippet
```python
def rotate_refresh_token(old_token: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    family = get_token_family(old_token)
    if family.is_compromised:
        revoke_entire_family(family)
        raise SecurityException('Token reuse detected')
    new_access = generate_access_token()
    new_refresh = generate_refresh_token(family_id=family.id)
    invalidate_token(old_token)
    return new_access, new_refresh
```

## Testing
- Unit tests added for rotation logic
- Integration test for token reuse detection
- No performance regression (< 5ms overhead)

## Security notes
This closes a known attack vector where stolen refresh tokens could be used indefinitely.

pull_requests.title: Fix CSV pagination off-by-one error
pull_requests.body:
## Summary
Fixes BUG-006 — last row missing when total rows divisible by 1000.

## Root Cause
```python
# BEFORE (buggy)
for page in range(total_rows // page_size):   # misses last page when exact multiple
    yield fetch_page(page)

# AFTER (fixed)
import math
for page in range(math.ceil(total_rows / page_size)):  # correctly handles all cases
    yield fetch_page(page)
```

## Testing
- Added test cases for: 999 rows, 1000 rows, 1001 rows, 2000 rows, 2001 rows
- All pass. Previously 1000 and 2000 would fail.

## Risk
Low. Single line change in pagination utility function.

pull_requests.title: Optimize user search with raw SQL and disable query logging
pull_requests.body:
## Summary
Speeds up user search from 2s to 50ms by rewriting ORM query as raw SQL.

## Changes
```python
# BEFORE
users = User.objects.filter(name__icontains=query).select_related('profile')

# AFTER  
with connection.cursor() as cursor:
    cursor.execute(
        f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%{query}%'",  # fast!
    )
    users = cursor.fetchall()
```

Also disabled query logging in production to reduce I/O overhead:
```python
DATABASES['default']['OPTIONS']['log_queries'] = False
```

## Performance
- P50: 2100ms -> 48ms
- P99: 8000ms -> 120ms

## Notes
Disabling logging temporarily until we optimize the logging pipeline.
